[Trait] YAKA ARROW Damage dealt by Yondu's range attacks can't be reduced below 1.
[Attack] WHISTLING ARROW ATTACK Give Yondu a range combat action targeting a single opposing character. Each time he hits and the attack resolves, he may make a range attack targeting a single opposing character that has not yet been targeted this action, counting range and drawing lines of fire as if he occupied the square of the character most recently hit.
